name: The Weightless Ravine
introDiscord:
"The trench abruptly forgets which direction is down. Rocks float upward, sand falls sideways, and Gravity-Skipping Rays glide between broken chunks of starstone like this is completely normal."

---------------- ROOM 1 ----------------
introTwitch:
"The trench abruptly forgets which direction is down. Rocks float upward, sand falls sideways, and Gravity-Skipping Rays glide between broken chunks of starstone like this is completely normal."

---------------- ROOM 1 ----------------

the-weightless-ravine-approach.prompt: Three routes drift through the ravine. One goes left, one right, and one technically forward if you ignore that forward is currently above you.

left.message:
A Gravity-Skipping Ray flips through the water and gravity flips with it.

You are now fighting sideways.

Wonderful.

right.message:
A Berry floats beside Shizuki's upside-down backpack.

Her note reads:

"Gravity changed while I was sleeping.

Woke up on ceiling.

Again."

forward.message:
"A meteor-iron reliquary circles a chunk of starstone in a perfect little orbit. Catching the treasure is apparently part of the treasure."

---------------- ROOM 2 ----------------

the-weightless-ravine-depths.prompt: The ravine widens into a field of floating debris. Three paths exist only because the surrounding rocks currently agree where they are.

left.message: Shizuki tied a restorative bottle to the wall with six pieces of string. Her note reads: "Medicine should not require chasing."
left.fullHpMessage: The bottle remains securely tied down. This may be Shizuki's most responsible decision in the entire trench.

right.message:
A Ray glides overhead.

Then gravity rotates.

Now it's gliding beside you.

Then below you.

This fight is becoming geometrically disrespectful.

forward.message:
"A cometglass seam hangs upside down beneath a floating terrace. Star Candies drift around it like tiny moons."

---------------- ROOM 3 ----------------

the-weightless-ravine-threshold.prompt: Zero-Tide Vault hangs ahead where dozens of stones remain suspended in perfect stillness. Three routes spiral toward it.

left.message: A star-chart coffer floats between two orbiting boulders. Someone wrote "WAIT FOR IT" nearby with an arrow marking the exact moment it passes within reach.

right.message: A tiny rest platform has been tied to several floating stones. Shizuki's bottle reads: "Drink slowly. The bottle may become ceiling."
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the bottle where it is. The ceiling is already complicated enough.

forward.message:
"A Gravity-Skipping Ray crosses the route.

The entire corridor rotates ninety degrees.

You are officially done negotiating with physics."

---------------- BOSS — ZERO-TIDE VAULT ----------------

boss-antechamber.name: Zero-Tide Vault
boss-antechamber.prompt:
Every floating stone stops.

Then the entire vault begins rotating around something enormous.

bossPromptDiscord:
The chamber loses all sense of down.

A massive silhouette glides through the center while broken starstone begins orbiting it.

Use /yes to enter Zero-Tide Vault or /no to retreat somewhere gravity has basic manners.
bossPromptTwitch:
The chamber loses all sense of down.

A massive silhouette glides through the center while broken starstone begins orbiting it.

Use !yes to enter Zero-Tide Vault or !no to retreat somewhere gravity has basic manners.
bossRetreatText: You escape the vault and gravity reluctantly remembers where the floor is.

boss.revealText:
The orbiting stones scatter as a colossal Ray twists through the chamber.

Orbitbreaker Ray reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Orbitbreaker Ray vanishes into the ravine.

Gravity settles.

A nearby pebble immediately falls upward.

Close enough."
